response.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT timespan, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_kept, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Orders with NULL timespan form one bucket (SQLite GROUP BY groups NULLs together); empty-string timespans, if any, would be a separate bucket.
If several orders share the same recordvault, each risk/margin record counts once per matching order row (plain inner join).
